title: An improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command vulnerability in the Auth API in Synology…
description: A critical SQL injection vulnerability exists in the Auth API of Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) versions before 7.2.1-69057-13, 7.2.2-72806-10, 7.3.2-86009-5, and 7.4.1-90080-1. This flaw allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and perform denial-of-service attacks without requiring authentication.
